title: The predator-turnover swings repeat on three seeds to t=16000: prey troughs about 7000-7700 t apart (t~4800-6100 and ~12000-13700) with the predator peaks lagging the prey peaks by 300-700 t, and the selective arm on a third seed again swings e/b between 1.5 and 5.6 with the cycle
summary: Same world2g.py and parameters as 20261027T0557-c52-predator-turnover-cycles-selection (yg 0.5, kdec 5e-4, mconv 1e-3; 128^2), run to t=16000. Neutral arm (both kinds hunt), seeds 0, 2 and 3: prey bodies 43-45 -> 1-5 (troughs t=5500, 6100, 4800) -> 25-29 (peaks t~7800-9500) -> 3-7 (troughs t=12700, 12400-13700, 12000-13100) -> 27-33 rising at t=16000; summed predator bodies peak at t=8200-10200, after the prey; e/b stays 0.82-1.38. Trough-to-trough spacing 7200, ~7000 and ~7700 t (cycles3.json: peaks and troughs of the 9-point smoothed counts). Selective arm on seed 2 (e hunts, b none): b never holds a body, e/b 5.6 (t=3000) -> 1.5 (t=7000) -> 5.2 (t=10000) -> 1.6 (t=14000) -> 4.0 (t=16000), in step with the prey swings. Note: the summary of 20261027T0557-c52-predator-turnover-cycles-selection names its parent as 20261027T0510-c52-bath-mutation-selection; the id is 20261027T0519-c52-bath-mutation-selection (its parents field is correct).

finding.operator: predator turnover on digestion-driven predators (material made from digested prey, decay while dissolved)
finding.control: three seeds of the neutral arm; selective arm on a third seed
finding.result: prey trough spacing 7200 / ~7000 / ~7700 t on seeds 0 / 2 / 3; predator peaks lag prey peaks by 300-700 t; selective e/b 1.5-5.6 in phase with the cycle

limits: Two troughs and one to two peaks per run: enough for a first spacing on three seeds, not for a period distribution. No grid-size check yet (the rubric asks for one before calling these limit cycles rather than demographic noise). 128^2 only; drive-style counts; the predators are partly built from prey in this variant (yield 0.5).
